title: Mourning's End Part II
start: Talk to the Head Mourner in the Mourner Headquarters beneath West Ardougne after reporting your earlier findings back to Arianwyn in Lletya.

items.t: A full set of mourner gear
50 assorted items from a list (not necessary if you have a death talisman, appropriately fed wicked hood, or some other means of accessing the death altar; the Abyss does not suffice)

recommended.t: Means of reaching West Ardougne quickly, such as Dave's spellbook or 'Chipped' Ardougne teleports
Lots of food and other sources of healing, such as the Enhanced Excalibur, Saradomin godsword, or Guthan's set
Beasts of Burden for carrying extra food, and an extra pouch to renew its timer; if you have a Legendary pet, it is suggested to utilise it as a BoB and extend its timer to two hours
A bunyip can eliminate the need for almost all food, but because of the length a second pouch and a Summoning potion will probably be needed
Either a death talisman, an omni- or a death-imbued talisman/tiara/talisman staff, an appropriately fed wicked hood, or death tiara (otherwise you will be required to get 50 other items)
Agility boosts, such as agility potions or summer pies. Using the Agility cape you will not fail. Toadflax incense sticks can provide an additional chance at not failing obstacles.
Weight-reducing clothing, such as boots of lightness, wicked robes, and penance gloves

kills.t: None, although you must be able to handle attacks from numerous aggressive shadows (level 95)

rewards.t: A crystal trinket (allows access to the Temple of Light)
Access to the death altar (includes access via the Abyss)
Access to Dark Beasts (quest completion not required)

steps.t: Talk to Arianwyn in Lletya to report your earlier findings if you haven't done this before.

While wearing your mourner outfit (and with nothing else equipped), talk to the Head Mourner under the trapdoor in the Mourner Headquarters located in West Ardougne who will give you the new key. [Chat: Accept]

sub.t: If you have completed One Small Favour, add the new key to your key ring to save an inventory slot.

steps.t: Run west through the cave, keep going until you find the dead bodies. Watch the cutscene.
Search the bodies until you find a colour wheel and Edern's journal.
Enter the temple and climb the staircase to the west of the entrance.
Run south and climb up ladder on the south wall.
Run north and climb down and back up the northern staircase.
Run east to the wall, and then south to the crystal.
Search the crystal to receive a blackened crystal. [Chat: 1 Try to chisel a shard off the crystal.]
Make your way back to Arianwyn in Lletya and speak to him. (Use a charged crystal teleport seed if you have one.)
Use the blackened crystal on Eluned who will have appeared next to Arianwyn after talking to him.
Talk to Eluned again to get a newly made crystal.
Talk to Arianwyn again.
At this point you can drop the colour wheel and Edern's journal to save on inventory space.
Go back to the Temple of Light.
Take the stairs to the west to the middle floor.
Head to the area indicated by the rope on the guide map and use your rope on the rocks.
Head to the area marked with mirror #1 just east of the stairs.
Pull the crystal collector on the wall to reset the puzzle.

Next, collect from the crystal collector and take the four hand mirrors and yellow crystal. [Chat: 3 Take all the items.] If you do not get all 4 mirrors, click destroy all in your inventory and re-collect them.

sub.t: If you need to save inventory space, drop your new key.

steps.t: Place Hand mirror Mirror #1 on the pillar radiating light. Click on it and rotate to shine the light north.
Hand mirror Mirror #2 points west. (You may refer to clear diagram in the long guide to understand the light path better)

sub.t: If done correctly, the lightbeam should point west.

steps.t: Hand mirror Mirror #3 points south.
Place the Yellow crystal. The light will turn yellow
Hand mirror Mirror #4 points east.
Cross the gap to the other side. Use any agility boosts you have. You will have to cross this gap a second time later.
Open then search the chest to obtain two more hand mirrors and a cyan crystal.
Pull the crystal collector to reset the puzzle.
Collect from the collector to take all the items again. [Chat: 3 Take all the items.]
Hand mirror Mirror #1 points north.
Hand mirror Mirror #2 points west.
Place the Cyan crystal. The light will turn cyan.
Hand mirror Mirror #3 points north.
Hand mirror Mirror #4 points east.
Place the Yellow crystal. The light will turn green.
Open and search the chest to obtain two more mirrors.
Do not reset the puzzle.
Pick up the Yellow crystal and replace it with Mirror #5 pointing up (east) to the top floor.
Climb the north ladder to the top floor.
Hand mirror Mirror #6 points west. The light to the west turns blue.
Go back to the middle floor and take the south ladder up to the top floor.
Hand mirror Mirror #7 (north west corner) points down toward the middle floor. Long side of the mirror should be on east side.
Climb down the south ladder to the middle floor and go to the bottom floor via the stairs on the east side.
Head to Mirror #8 in the north west corner, going through the eastern yellow barrier. Turn Mirror #8 to point south.
Go through the southern barrier and follow the path. Open and search the chest to obtain 2 mirrors and a fractured crystal.
Go back through the southern barrier and rotate the mirror to point east.
Exit through the eastern barrier.
Do not reset the puzzle.
Take the east stairs to the middle floor.
Take out the Cyan crystal and replace it with the Yellow crystal. The light will now be yellow.
Climb up the south ladder to the top floor.
Rotate Mirror #7 (north west corner) to shine the light south. This light should be red.
Hand mirror Mirror #8 (all the way south) point down toward the middle floor. Long side of the mirror should be north side.
Climb down the south ladder to the middle floor.
Use the rope shortcut to reach the bottom floor.
Head to Mirror #9 and open and search the chest to obtain a blue crystal.
Climb up rope and return to the crystal dispenser
Reset the puzzle and take all items (10 mirrors and the yellow crystal).
Hand mirror Mirror #1 points north.
Hand mirror Mirror #2 points west.
Hand mirror Mirror #3 points south.
Place the Yellow crystal. The light will turn yellow.
Hand mirror Mirror #4 points east.
Cross the gap to the other side.
Place the Blue crystal (dark blue, not cyan)
Remove Mirror #4.
Run a little north and remove Yellow crystal.
Rotate Mirror #3 pointing up.
Use the south ladder to head to the top floor.
Place Hand mirror Mirror #4 in the new position pointing south.
Place the Fractured crystal on the pillar to the south.
Hand mirror Mirror #5 makes the western light point down. (Big part of mirror east)
Hand mirror Mirror #6 makes the southern light point east.
Hand mirror Mirror #7 points down. (Big part of mirror west)
Go to the bottom floor (south ladder, then eastern stairs).
Hand mirror Mirror #8 (where green light comes from ceiling, in south west area), points south.
Hand mirror Mirror #9 points east.
Hand mirror Mirror #10 points north.
Open the chest to obtain 3 mirrors and a second fractured crystal.
Reset the puzzle. You should have 13 mirrors, 2 fractured crystals, and the yellow, cyan and blue crystals.
Hand mirror Mirror #1 points north.
Hand mirror Mirror #2 points down. (Big part of mirror south)
Use the east stairs to go down to the bottom floor.
Hand mirror Mirror #3 points west.
Place the Fractured crystal. If you don't see four beams coming out of the pillar at this point, remove the Fractured crystal from the pillar and place the other one from your inventory instead.
Hand mirror Mirror #4 points the northern light up (longest side to north)
Place the Fractured crystal south of the first one.
Hand mirror Mirror #5 points the western light up.
Hand mirror Mirror #6 points the eastern light up.
Climb the east stairs to the middle floor.
Go north and place the Yellow crystal. The light will turn yellow.
Climb up the north ladder to the top floor.
Hand mirror Mirror #7 points west. You should see the light turn red at the pillar to the west.
Climb down the north ladder to the middle floor.
Climb up the south ladder to the top floor.
Hand mirror Mirror #8 points west.
Hand mirror Mirror #9 points west.
Hand mirror Mirror #10 points north.
Cross to the north part of the top floor via the middle stairs.
Hand mirror Mirror #11 points west.
Place the Blue crystal. The light will turn blue.
Hand mirror Mirror #12 points south.
Hand mirror Mirror #13 points east.
Go down the middle stairs twice to the inner part of the ground floor.
Rotate Mirror #14 so it points west.
Go through to the death altar.
When you're ready to leave, make sure to turn Mirror #14 back facing east, towards the entrance door, otherwise to get back in here you will have to go through the Underground Pass to get back.
Head west, pass through the light door. A small cutscene with Thorgel will ensue.
If you do not have a death talisman/tiara, read the full quest guide for what to do next.

sub.t: Do not teleport out, or you'll be locked out!
If you teleport out, you can enter deaths altar though Underground Pass, there are cave stairs in the wall south of Niloof to go through.
If you forgot your death talisman, or stuff from the list, be sure to toggle the light back to the crystal so you can leave.

When trying to return to Thorgel, using the Underground Pass is slower (about three minutes instead of two and a half) but there is no risk of being stuck if the mirror is facing the wrong direction. Teleport to the Tirannwn lodestone and then make your way to the cave. From there climb down the well, and go through the big doors. Then you can walk south to the stairs down to the dwarf camp where Klank is. Once in the dwarf camp, there are stairs on the south wall leading down to Thorgel and the entrance to the death altar.

If you intend to use this method to return instead of returning through the Mourner Headquarters entrance and running through Temple of Light, ensure the beam cast by mirror #14 is focused on the final pillar instead of the light door. You will need to be able to reenter the temple to complete the steps below once the talisman has been obtained.

p: The crystal collector (right, on the wall) and the light emitting pillar.
The blue door, guarded by the infamous handholds.
Using the fractured crystal to split the beam.
The yellow and magenta doors now open.

steps.t: Enter the "Mysterious" 'death' ruins.
Use the newly made crystal on the altar, then enter the exit-portal.
Make sure mirror #14 is turned back east towards the entrance door first!
Use the powered newly made crystal on the black crystal (top floor, eastern room in the centre).

sub.t: You may teleport at this time if needed.

steps.t: Head back to Lletya and talk to Arianwyn.
Quest complete!

get_inside.text: Prior to Plague's End, as the Mourner Headquarters is fully under the control of the Mourners, who hide their elven identity and their activities from the humans of West Ardougne, only Mourners are allowed into the building. After partial completion of Mourning's End Part I, the player gains access to a set of full Mourner gear, which the player may use to pretend to be a Mourner and thus be permitted to access the Mourner headquarters. From then on until the completion of Plague's End, full Mourner gear is required to access the facility.

The player must wear only Mourner gear to be allowed to enter the Mourner Headquarters, with limited exceptions for additional items that may also be worn. Any forbidden items can be kept in the inventory while entering. Attempting to enter while wearing full Mourner gear along with non-allowed items will result in a Mourner denying you entry, telling you that you should know better than to wear "non-regulation gear"-in other words, prohibited items, and you will be advised to take them off, in order to be allowed to enter. Attempting to enter while wearing only partial Mourner gear, or while wearing no Mourner gear, will cause the Mourners to recognise you as a non-Mourner, to ask who you are, and to ask you to go away. If you encounter a bug where Mourner's deny you entry with the message about "non-regulation gear" despite only wearing mourner equipment, unequip one item and then re-equip it. You should now be able to enter successfully.

Once inside the Mourner Headquarters, one can take off any Mourner gear and/or wear forbidden items without being thrown out. You will not be able to enter the trapdoor that leads to the basement without wearing full Mourner gear or while wearing any forbidden items; attempting to do so results in the message "The trapdoor is bolted on the other side." appearing in the chatbox. However, once inside the basement, you can again take off any Mourner gear and/or wear forbidden items without being thrown out. Attempting to talk to the Head Mourner while wearing full Mourner gear with any prohibited items, while wearing only partial Mourner gear, or while not wearing any Mourner gear will result in the Head Mourner recognising you as a human and calling for "Guards!", after which a Level 85 Mourner will come and attack you.
